label: t20 = t19 plus the CRISPRi cis head: 2 x the K562 median repression by TSS distance (panel targets excluded) added within 5 kb, outside the amplitude; shrunk K562, CD4, HCT116 at equal weights, gamma 1, amplitude 1.576, trial-01 generator
claim_type: prediction registered before generation and submission; not a measurement

references.t19: registered, not scored; the reference of this comparison

evidence_used: reports/modulo_cis_2026-09-26/: on held-out public sources the cis head raises the pds proxy on the t19 shape by +0.0024..+0.0061 in effect space (r2) and by +0.0012..+0.0048 through the generator model (r3), every interval above zero, shuffled neighbour sets at zero; the first step of reach (right sign at the head of the held-out significant genes) +0.001..+0.026; sign precision and detectable genes unchanged; squared error ratio +0.000..+0.001. The head touches the about 60-75 targets with a neighbour within 5 kb; the rest of each prediction is t19's. The generator uses one random stream, so every cell after the first changed target is a new draw: t20 - t19 carries generator noise of unknown size.

reading_rule_fixed_before_the_result.t20 >= t19 + 0.005: the cis head helps beyond the noise: it stays in the reference model and becomes the default for the final set; next, its dose (scale 4) on the bench and then officially
reading_rule_fixed_before_the_result.t20 <= t19 - 0.005: the head hurts on the official score: it leaves the A/B/C reference, and the members that moved are examined (overshoot of neighbour knockdowns in nmae or the DE members) before it is used for D/E/F
reading_rule_fixed_before_the_result.otherwise: non-inferior within resolution (the expected case): the head stays in the reference, because it is the only component that predicts targets no source measured, which the final set will have
reading_rule_fixed_before_the_result.if t19 is not scored: t20 - t16 reads shrinkage and cis head together, with t19's thresholds; it cannot separate them
